# runr_binding_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a `runr_binding` to a project: the binding's connection details reach the project's functions as environment variables (with `env_prefix` in front, e.g. `ORDERS_DATABASE_URL`). Attaching, changing the prefix or the credentials and detaching roll the running service; nothing needs to be redeployed.

A `kv`, `object` or `postgres` binding can be attached to projects of its region; external bindings to any project. With `environment` the binding is attached to one environment of the project instead of its own workload (it must be in the region the environment runs in); bindings are never inherited, and a binding is attached to at most one environment of a project. Needs `env.edit` on the project and `bindings.manage`. Import with `<project name or id>/<binding name or id>` or `<project name or id>/<environment>/<binding name or id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# orders-api gets ORDERS_DATABASE_URL, ORDERS_PGHOST, … and REDIS_URL, KV_PREFIX.
resource "runr_binding_attachment" "orders_db" {
  project_id = runr_project.api.id
  binding_id = runr_binding.orders_db.id
  env_prefix = "ORDERS_"
}

resource "runr_binding_attachment" "cache" {
  project_id = runr_project.api.id
  binding_id = runr_binding.cache.id
}

output "binding_variables" {
  value = concat(runr_binding_attachment.orders_db.env_names, runr_binding_attachment.cache.env_names)
}

# staging gets a database of its own (bindings are never inherited), with a Postgres user of the
# attachment's own from the OpenBao of its region.
resource "runr_binding_attachment" "staging_db" {
  project_id  = runr_project.api.id
  environment = runr_environment.staging.name
  binding_id  = runr_binding.staging_db.id
  env_prefix  = "ORDERS_"
  credentials = "dynamic"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_id` (String) Binding id (`runr_binding.<name>.id`).
- `project_id` (String) Project id.

### Optional

- `credentials` (String) `static` (the binding's own user; the default) or `dynamic`: a Postgres user of the attachment's own from the OpenBao of its region, renewed by RunR (a ready `postgres` binding; the region runs OpenBao and External Secrets Operator). Changed in place. Left out, the attachment keeps its credentials.
- `env_prefix` (String) Prefix of the variable names: upper case letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter and ending with `_` (default: none). Changing it updates the attachment in place.
- `environment` (String) Environment of the project the binding is attached to (`runr_environment.<name>.name` or its id): its variables go into the environment's bindings Secret and only its pods may reach the binding. Left out (or `production`): the project's own workload. Changing it attaches the binding anew.

### Read-Only

- `env_names` (List of String) The variables the project gets from this attachment.
- `id` (String) Attachment id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project name or id>/<binding name or id>
terraform import runr_binding_attachment.orders_db orders-api/orders-db

# An attachment of an environment: <project name or id>/<environment>/<binding name or id>
terraform import runr_binding_attachment.staging_db orders-api/staging/orders-db-staging
```
